items.message: River levels remain high but steady at the Penkridge gauge, so the risk of flooding remains. Further rainfall is forecast today. Flooding may affect low-lying land and roads adjacent to the River Sow between Great Bridgeford and Shugborough, the River Penk between Coven and Stafford, the Sandyford Brook, the Rising Brook, the Ridings Brook and the Saredon Brook. We are closely monitoring the situation and monitoring rainfall and river levels. Avoid using low lying footpaths and any bridges near local watercourses. Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water. This message will be updated by 11:00AM on Sunday 25 October or as the situation changes.

High tides over the next three days may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 3:30PM to 5:30PM on Friday 23rd October and from 4:30PM to 6:30PM on Saturday 24th October. 
High tides, strong winds and large waves may lead to flooding. Flooding of roads and low lying land is possible around the high tides this afternoon, 23/10/2026, and tomorrow Afternoon. Areas most at risk include the coastline between Gore Point and Hurlstone Point, including Porlock Weir.

The detailed tidal forecast, is for a peak level at Hinkley Point. The first forecast high water is at 4:30 PM on 23/10/2026, with a level of 4.72 mAODN with Westerly force 8  winds. The second forecast high water is at 5:30 PM on 24/10/2026, with a level of 6.04 mAODN with South Westerly force 6 winds. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water.   
This message will be updated by 3:00PM on Saturday 24 October or as the situation changes.

High tides on Friday may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible for 2 hours either side of Friday evening's tide at 21:15 on 23/10/2026. 
Storm Austen is causing difficult coastal conditions, including large waves which are coinciding with high tides. A small amount of spray overtopping will affect footpaths, seafront parking and the road at Marine Parade and the Esplanade. Tide table values are increasing by 0.04 m. Total forecast tide is 6.09 metres Chart Datum (2.57 mAOD) at Newhaven. Gale Force 8 Westerly wind. Similar conditions are likely to persist until 27/10/2026. Saturday's tide at 09:30 on 24/10/2026 is forecast to be 0.53 m higher (3.1 mAOD). 
We are maintaining beaches . 
Don't put yourself or others at risk.   
This message will be updated by 6:00PM on Saturday 24 October or as the situation changes.
